resource: Pass deadline of the operator public projection resync (oteryn-game-ops public-projection resync), PostgreSQL transaction, statement and lock timeouts included
allocation_impact: No allocation in the Game process. The resync is one transaction of set-based statements (one per family): it touches every Character and every highscores pair and queues one outbox row each, server-side. A resync that does not finish within 60 s rolls back whole; the epoch and every revision stay as they were and the operator re-runs it.
boundary_tests: apps/game-server/tests/support/public_projections_postgres_cases.rs: a full resync with an epoch raise of 10,000 Characters and 704 highscores pairs commits within the deadline and queues every subject at the new epoch
notes: Contract sections 5 and 8. The resync runs with the node stopped (store recovery), so no gameplay pass waits behind it; the ordinary DB_PASS_DEADLINE (2 s) does not bound it. Bounded by the root's longest pass deadline (60 s, NODE-BOOT-DEADLINE-1). Sized for a store of 1,000,000 Characters plus all their highscores pairs (about 30 s at about 30 us per subject); if a resync exceeds it, re-run one family at a time, and if a single family still exceeds it, that is a blocker for the contract owner, resolved by a contract change and never by editing this deadline in place. Internal Game-to-Platform boundary; no client wire. Registered by OTV2-20261015-public-projections-producer.
